title: Maxwell's Equations
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state Maxwell's equations in the absence of dielectrics or magnetic materials.

title: Unit System
description: Essential Criteria: The student must specify the MKSA system of units used in the solution.

title: Charge Reversal Effects
description: Important Criteria: The student must explain how reversing the signs of source charges affects the electric and magnetic fields.

title: Space Inversion Effects
description: Important Criteria: The student must describe the changes to charge density, current density, electric field, and magnetic field under space inversion.

title: Time Reversal Effects
description: Important Criteria: The student must articulate the effects on charge density, current density, electric field, and magnetic field under time reversal.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes when discussing the effects of charge reversal and transformations.

title: Field Direction
description: Optional Criteria: The student may provide additional insights on the direction of electric and magnetic fields after transformations.

title: Consistency Check
description: Optional Criteria: The student may verify that Maxwell's equations remain consistent under the transformations discussed.
